$comment: Declarative privileges and row-level security for every relation in a tenant schema. Applied after migrations by the provisioner (new tenants) and scripts/migrate-tenants.mjs (existing tenants). Grants are reset to exactly what is listed here on every run. A relation that exists in a tenant schema but is not listed makes the run fail, so a module that adds a table must declare its access here. 'runtime' is the tenant's per-request role (SET LOCAL ROLE); 'login' is the pooled login role, used without a role switch only for session bookkeeping. 'rls': true enables and forces the tenant-context policy; 'tenantColumn' additionally binds rows to app.tenant_id through that column.
